programme.title: 3-03 Rescate
programme.desc: Debora Lopez is a cop with an unbreakable faith and limitless will to protect and serve. Her life takes a dark turn when she participates in a raid that ends up in tragedy. Now, she will fight for her belief in a better and more humane police service.

programme.title: Prediccion Fatal
programme.desc: A tarot reading seems to point to Manuel as the one who caused the death of Acrisio, an unscrupulous politician who is the father of Danna, this young man's girlfriend. Now Manuel must run to save his life and free Danna.

programme.title: Los Pistoleros
programme.desc: In search of money, women and fame, a group of friends enter the world of the mafia as hired guns.

programme.title: Madres Michoacanas
programme.desc: When criminals take Michoacan, the women of the town fear for their children, who could be drafted by the new mafia.

programme.title: Tainted Getaway
programme.desc: What was meant to be a once-in-a-lifetime job opportunity for Allison Haven becomes a nightmare when she's abducted by escape convict Brock Bremmer, who vows to retrieve his lost money from a tragic past. Little does he know an old nemesis, Mason, is hot on his trail to retrieve it as well, including the authorities who will stop at nothing to bringing them to justice.

programme.title: Resguardado
programme.desc: Daniel was miraculously cured as a child after dreaming with his dead stepmother. Affected by growing up without a mother, a grown-up Daniel will have to reconnect with his past to fix his present and future.

programme.title: Ovnis En Zacapa
programme.desc: Robert Daneri, a frustrated college professor, travels with a sensationalist TV show crew to Zacapa, northwestern Guatemala, where they’ll have to uncover the truth behind a series of UFO sighting that had supposedly occurred in the area.

programme.title: Combativo
